title: Burroughs suffers physical effects

tellings.quote: the other Witnesses John buroughs a US Air Force Airman also experienced physical and psychological effects

plain: After a reported UFO encounter in Rendlesham Forest in England in 1980, a US Air Force airman named John Burroughs, one of the witnesses, is said to have suffered physical and psychological effects. Michels mentions this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about UFOs seen near nuclear bases. If true, it would mean the encounter did lasting harm to the people who were there.
